{{Quote|Please&mdash;call me Roki. Everyone does.|Rokari Kem|<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Ascension" />}}
'''Rokari Kem''', nicknamed '''Roki Kem''', was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Jessar]] freedom fighter from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Qaras]]. Following a successful [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] [[Revolt on Qaras|revolt]] on her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] against the [[Minyavish]], Qaras became a member state of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]]. Soon afterward, Kem was elected as her planet's [[Senator/Legends|representative]] to the [[Galactic Alliance Senate|Senate]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. By this time, however, she had been possessed by the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[Sentience/Legends|entity]] known as [[Abeloth]]. After the assassination of [[Padnel Ovin]], Abeloth used her [[Force power/Legends|powers]] of [[Mind trick/Legends|persuasion]], as well as Kem's popularity, to sway members of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] and then win the emergency election to become the next [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]]. With Chief Kem under her control, Abeloth, along with the Lost Tribe, controlled the entire Galactic Alliance. Abeloth's use of Kem's body was causing it to deteriorate rapidly, as she was not Force-sensitive and could not handle the amount of power that Abeloth possessed. Kem was later killed by [[Wynn Dorvan]] while she went into a trance for Abeloth to enter the Jedi Temple's computer core, during the Liberation of Coruscant.
